falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 calendar days, the S&P 500 closes at least 3.5% above its signal-date close and at a new 63-session high, while the VIX closes below 14 on that same session.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A volatility-confirmed breakout falsifies the mini_top_2019_jun analog and the moderate blowoff reading; UNKNOWN/HOLD would be wrong because the tape resolved as trend continuation, not a top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 calendar days, the S&P 500 closes at least 5% below its signal-date close on a session when the VIX also closes above 24.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp, volatility-confirmed drawdown would show the mini-top pattern already resolved into risk-off; UNKNOWN/HOLD would be wrong because the correct call was a sell or risk reduction, not indecision.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 calendar days, ICE BofA US High Yield option-adjusted spread widens by 50 basis points or more from its signal-date level, or the share of S&P 500 constituents above their 50-day moving average falls by at least 15 percentage points from the signal-date reading.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A discrete credit or breadth break would prove the regime was already knowable as distribution; UNKNOWN/HOLD would be invalidated because cross-asset stress confirmed the top analog rather than an unresolved setup.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
